proves.claim: clause 1: nextOnce with values.wait above 0 and a ready open item claims it for the calling seat and returns no waitingOffer.

moves.selection.wait-claims-ready-item.why: Seats looping on next --wait were offered the item and raced other seats to claim it, losing HELD repeatedly (#11846).

proves.claim: clause 2: nextOnce with values.wait above 0 and an item the seat already holds returns the held item with no second claim.

moves.selection.wait-held-unchanged.why: The held path must stay unchanged once waiting claims like plain next (#11846).
